photos.name: crumb-shot-sparse-cheese
photos.summary: Crumb shot of the sliced boule held up to camera with second half on cutting board behind it. Open, airy crumb structure with large irregular holes throughout. Only a couple small melted cheddar pockets visible near the bottom of the slice — cheese distribution is sparse. Thin, well-colored crust visible on the edges. White cutting board and purple-handled bread knife on stone countertop.

photos.name: crust-closeup-cheese-patches
photos.summary: Close-up top-down view of the boule crust still on wire cooling rack. Melted cheddar has oozed out through small openings in the crust surface, creating caramelized golden-brown cheese patches scattered across the top. Flour dusting visible between the score marks. The X-score pattern is visible with cheese bubbling up through the cuts. Shows how the cheese migrated to the surface during baking despite sparse distribution inside.

photos.name: finished-boule-cooling-rack
photos.summary: Finished sourdough cheddar boule cooling on a round wire rack on stone countertop. VSCO edit with warm tones. Deep golden-brown crust with good oven spring and a bold X-score that opened up well. Flour dusting on the score flaps contrasts against the dark caramelized crust. Decent rise for a first bake — round, tall shape with no blowouts. Some darkening along the top edges from the Dutch oven lid.
